titol: la possibilitat de no haver sigut
text: Participation in the curatorial panel for the group exhibition as member and coordinator of Grup d'Estudi.
La possibilitat de no haver sigut works as an annex to the exhibition Antifuturismo Cimarrón and starts from the following question: what would happen if Europe, as a trope, had never existed?

Bearing in mind the paradox of raising this question within the museum institution and within European territory, Grup d'Estudi has chosen to approach the curatorial task as an exercise of reflection on the working process itself, problematising the commission and proposing a counter-narrative. This is expressed graphically and performatively, intervening in the exhibition formats and the mediation and activities programme.
Co-curating: Grup d'Estudi, Difraccions, Flux, Jiser and Sabers Migrants, Kònic Thtr, Mixtur and Sâlmon.
